lessons: LATCH DEMONSTRATED LIVE: SFHG printed +11.4% at 06:47, faded to +8.4% by 07:02 and vanished from the scan. It remained a ranked candidate because the +10% cross had already printed. A snapshot-only scanner would have silently shrunk the universe here.
